crew.name: Dr. Kenji Sato
crew.scenario_description: Sleep starts to decline around day 32, then mood drops and exercise slips, and resting heart rate and blood pressure climb. Shows how AURA catches a behavioural-health pattern before it becomes a cardiovascular event.

crew.name: Amara Diallo
crew.scenario_description: Latent viral reactivation causes a fever that builds from day 54 and becomes critical, with a raised heart rate and falling SpO2.
